run.notes: Single benchmark run per configuration; a kernel study on this stack measured run-to-run cv <= 0.3% under greedy decoding with static shapes.

model.architecture_notes: KV sharing: only 15 of 35 layers hold KV tensors (num_kv_shared_layers=20), single 256-dim KV head; ~15 KiB KV per token in bf16, ~7.5 KiB under fp8.

load_matrix.error: int4 compressed-tensors scheme unimplemented for E2B's per_layer_model_projection
loader demands self_attn.k_norm.weight for KV-shared layers 15-34 that the checkpoint legitimately omits
identical missing-weights error as the JAX path

capabilities.notes: ~280 prompt tokens per image. Server-side fetching of external image URLs is flaky (intermittent 422s) — base64 data URIs are the reliable path. First multimodal request after boot can 422 while the processor warms; retry once.

memory.notes: Measured on a bf16-KV boot at 0.9 utilization (28.12 GiB working set); kv_bytes_per_token/resident_kv_tokens are for the default fp8_e5m2 cache. fp8 vs bf16 KV: 6 of 6 greedy outputs byte-identical.

startup.notes: From VM RUNNING: Docker ~60s, image pull ~360s, weights+compile+health ~510s. 200 GB boot disk required; 10 GB default cannot hold the vLLM image.

cost.notes: Breakeven vs Flash-Lite at ~940 sustained output tok/s (~c=8 held continuously). A full 4-hour session costs $5.40 and delivers ~30M output tokens at saturation.

issues.summary: Gemma 4 E2B loader demands per-layer k_norm/v_norm that KV-shared layers legitimately lack; blocks both QAT checkpoint variants

notes: Direct SSH silently times out on some networks even when the VPC allows tcp:22 — use IAP tunneling (gcloud compute ssh --tunnel-through-iap, or start-iap-tunnel for port 8000).
vLLM auto-selects fp8_e5m2 KV cache on v6e — the largest memory consumer is 8-bit before any weight quantization.
Capacity planning: run at <=64 concurrent streams; ceiling ~17 req/s at this workload shape; knee between c=32 and c=64.
